messages:
anya: FYI — postmortem finished. Starting a compact follow-up thread to lock down remediation ownership for the token validation gaps, audit logging shortfalls, and secrets rotation. TL;DR: some service tokens had TTL >30d, audit events missing for a subset of service-account rotations, and ~12 stale secrets need rotation.
sarah: ack. can we split into owners + clear due dates? i can take the audit retention changes and post-rotate verification checklist.
mike: i'll take the token validation script + CI job. will also wire an alert if ttl drift spikes.
daniel: i'll own the rotation playbook updates and run the bulk secret rotate once we're green on the prechecks. need consensus on TTL defaults (user vs service).
anya: proposal: user tokens max 30d, service tokens max 7d. i'll put that in the runbook and in the postmortem notes. @sarah please own audit retention increments.
sarah: ack. i'll open infra ticket to bump retention defaults: 90d general, 365d enterprise. will coordinate with compliance for the change window.
infra-bot: New ticket created: INFRA-4721 — increase audit retention defaults (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-4721)
mike: here's the draft CI smoke i'll add:
```
# token validation smoke
python tools/token_checks.py --project prod --max-ttl 30
```
I'll also add a PagerDuty policy if the job finds >1% of tokens over threshold.
anya: secrets rotation: ops-catalog shows ~12 keys outstanding across prod and staging. who can run the bulk rotate?
daniel: i can run the bulk rotate next Friday 09:00 PT. estimate ~2 hours with a short maintenance window. will publish a runbook and rollback steps.
sarah: pre-rotate checklist: list principals that access each secret, run `k8s get secrets -o wide` and verify no pod dependencies, and snapshot audit logs before rotate. i'll draft the checklist.
mike: note: we need to update the SDK credential refresh docs — rotates may require minor client-side changes. i'll make a small doc PR.
anya: action items summary (added to postmortem):
- mike: add token validation CI job + PagerDuty alert — due 2026-04-02
- sarah: file INFRA-4721 + implement audit retention changes + pre/post-rotate checklist — due 2026-03-31
- daniel: run bulk secrets rotate + post-rotate verification — due 2026-04-09
- anya: update runbook TTL policy + record postmortem follow-up + close loop with product/security — due 2026-03-28
sarah: adding to remediation tracker sheet: https://docs.redwood/remediation/pm-2026-q1
mike: quick q — audit gaps: which services had missing events? i saw gaps in envoy-proxy and authz-api.
anya: confirmed: both. envoy was accidentally on sampling in prod for a subset of nodes, and authz-api had a bug dropping rotation events from the audit pipeline. ENG-5903 created for envoy sampling flip.
eng-platform: noted. ENG-5903 created and assigned to platform-ops (https://tracker.redwood/ENG-5903).
sarah: thanks everyone. if no blockers i'll mark this thread resolved and link tasks into the remediation sprint board. re-open here if anything blocks :thumbsup:
